title: Musical glasses
summary: Musical glasses are a row of wine glasses, each filled with a different amount of water. A wet fingertip drawn round a rim makes the glass sing, and the more water a glass holds the lower its note.
howToPlay: Ten glasses are lit: the fullest, lowest ones in front and the highest ones behind.
Play the glass a closing ring marks. Its rim glows and the water ripples as it sings.
Notes swell slowly and last a moment, so start each one on time and let it sound.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: Tuning a glass with water was a parlour trick and a concert art in Europe. Players tuned a set to a scale and played whole tunes on them.
credits: Tradition: musical glasses; patterns written for this game
